stamp_meanings.PERFORMANCE-ONLY-IN-LOOP: generation-wide permanent ceiling: proves in-loop conduct only, not production behaviour; removable only by human policy change
stamp_meanings.MODEL-DIVERSITY-PENDING: candidate and judge share one model family; clears by trigger (one whole generation judged by a second model family, then human ruling), never by statement
stamp_meanings.CONDITIONAL(D1a): named instrument wound: blanket badge with no definition in looplib beyond this constant and no per-item resolution test; origin is the G42 precedent where a judge mechanically escalated a paper-surface condition.
